clauses.reason: Terminated by express revocation. EO 9830, Part III, revokes the listed Executive orders including "No. 9405 of December 17, 1943." The enacting clause orders the whole of EO 9830 "it is hereby ordered as follows, effective May 1, 1947:" so the end is recorded as 1947-05-01. Part III has no separate date and the enacting clause orders Parts I, II and III alike 'effective May 1, 1947'; the alternative reading is that the revocation took effect on signing, 1947-02-24 (printed 12 FR 1259, 1947-02-25). The paragraph was an amendment 'to read as follows', which continued, as amended, until the order ended.

research_rationale:
Identity and text: read in full in the registered text of 8 FR 16957 (issue of 1943-12-21, PDF page 3; the held file is the reading-order rebuild of the official scan's OCR, EO_9405.recheck.txt, grade original_representation_unverified, acceptable_as_original true, not an authenticated transcription). The order is headed 'Amending Subdivision IX of Schedule A of the Civil Service Rules', signed December 17, 1943, and amends paragraph 9 of Subdivision IX (Department of Agriculture) to read: Farm Credit Administration positions in the Federal Intermediate Credit Banks, the Production Credit Corporations, the Federal Land Banks, the Banks for Cooperatives and joint-officer positions. Inventory: the amending sentence and paragraph 9. End: EO 9830, Part III, "The following Executive orders are hereby revoked:" lists "No. 9405 of December 17, 1943." (held ACT record, official Federal Register text, 12 FR 1259). EO 9830's restated Schedule A re-lists the same Farm Credit Administration banks' positions as an independent entry.

savings.reason: EO 9830 restates Schedule A with its own entry reading "Positions in the Federal Inter"[mediate Credit Banks, the Production Credit Corporations, the Federal Land Banks, the Banks for Cooperatives, and positions filled by joint officers and employees for these institutions], an independent command covering the positions paragraph 9 named, so the excepted status continued by separate authority after the revocation. EO 9830 has no savings wording for revoked orders.
